decision_table.name: Determine_AK_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Alaska state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in Alaska (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Alaska filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Physical presence includes: - Office or place of business in Alaska - Employees working in Alaska - Property (real or tangible personal) located in Alaska
Reference: AK Stat. § 43.20.011 et seq. Reference: Alaska Department of Revenue - Tax Division Reference: AK Form 6000 Instructions

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Alaska filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair).
Economic nexus threshold: - $100,000 or more in gross receipts from Alaska sales, OR - 200 or more separate transactions with Alaska customers
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: Alaska Department of Revenue Economic Nexus Guidance Reference: AK Stat. § 43.20.011
No Alaska nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_AK_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate Alaska state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
Alaska state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Alaska generally conforms to federal taxable income definitions with minimal state-specific modifications.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations (if required) - Other Alaska-specific additions as defined by statute
Subtractions may include: - Alaska-specific deductions as allowed by statute - State NOL deduction (if different from federal)
Reference: AK Stat. § 43.20.011 through 43.20.144 Reference: AK Form 6000 Instructions Reference: Alaska Department of Revenue Publication
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_AK_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Alaska state corporate income tax. Applies 9.3% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
Alaska state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to Alaska: × [Three-factor apportionment %] - Property factor: AK property / Total property - Payroll factor: AK payroll / Total payroll - Sales factor: AK sales / Total sales - Average of three factors 3. State additions: + [Additions per table 52320] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions per table 52320] 5. Alaska taxable income: = [Result] 6. Alaska tax rate: × 9.3% 7. Alaska income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. Alaska credits: - [Credits] 9. Alaska tax liability: = [Final tax]
Tax Rate: 9.3% flat rate on Alaska taxable income (One of the highest corporate income tax rates in the United States)
Reference: AK Stat. § 43.20.011 (Tax rate: 9.3%) Reference: AK Form 6000 (Corporation Net Income Tax Return) Reference: AK Stat. § 43.19 (Apportionment) Reference: Alaska Department of Revenue - Tax Division
No Alaska nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No Alaska taxable income - no tax liability. Alaska NOL rules may apply (not implemented). Any estimated payments are refunded.
